messages:
sara-sales: FYI incoming SIG/CAIQ from VantageAI — they want answers by EOD Tue so they can greenlight the POC. attaching PDF and the questionnaire link: https://docs.google.com/drive/fake/vantage-sig (short thread to assign owner)
jordan-sec: @sara-sales can you confirm if the POC will process PHI or any regulated data? that will change scoping and SLA.
sara-sales: Not PHI. It's customer product metadata + embeddings from public data. No regulated data per their sec contact.
alex.k: I can take this. quick Q: do we have a prior answers doc for a similar customer? saves time.
mike-support: We filled a few fields for a prior fintech POC in Zendesk ticket #4521 — I can export. Also have a partial control matrix in Confluence.
alex.k: perfect, pls drop the Zendesk export link here. I'll triage and identify any 'no' or partials that need engineering input.
sara-sales: Zendesk export: https://redwood.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/4521/export — @alex.k also note Vantage wants a signed SIG if we can — they asked about KMS/HSM and on-prem options.
jordan-sec: KMS/HSM is an enterprise-only fit; default answer is 'supported via customer-managed keys in Private deployments' — mark as engineering follow-up for Dedicated/Hosted differences.
risk-bot: [Automated] New questionnaire assigned to security queue. SLA window: 72 hours. Please update status on assignment.
alex.k: Copying a quick triage checklist:
```
- Confirm data classification
- Verify encryption at rest (KMS vs platform-managed)
- Check access controls (SCIM/SSO/roles)
- Confirm retention / deletion policy
- Verify logging & audit availability
- Note any 3rd-party subprocessors
```
alex.k: I'll start answers now. If we hit any 'no' on controls (e.g., HSM for hosted) I'll flag for product/engineering.
sara-sales: Customer will start POC demo next Wed — if we need to gate the demo based on outstanding 'no' answers, call it out.
jordan-sec: Agreed. If >1 critical control is unmet, flag as 'POC hold' and advise customer on mitigation (can use Dedicated trial or reduced scope).
alex.k: Owner assigned: alex.k. ETA for first pass: Tue EOD (matches request). I'll upload answers to the shared doc and ping this thread when done.
mike-support: Dropped the Zendesk export and Confluence matrix in #files — look for 'vantage-export-4521.json' and 'control-matrix-v1'
sara-sales: Awesome, thanks team. @alex.k please mark status = "in-progress" and update when you need eng input. :thumbsup:
alex.k: Will do — updating now: https://docs.google.com/fake/vantage-sig-answers (doc set to internal view).
notes: thread is sales->security intake + owner assignment for SIG/CAIQ; short turns, POC gating consideration; includes bot automated SLA reminder
